title: Configured database connection ceilings
method: Synthetic deployment: 3 replicas × workers per replica × 8 connections per worker. Two workers yields 48; four yields 96. Overflow, administrators, migrations and other clients are excluded; actual concurrency is not measured.
alt: Configured database connection ceilings. Two workers per replica: 48 connections; Four workers per replica: 96 connections. Illustrative inputs.
